# Review journal

Gestures applied to refs by `openclew review`. `auto` = deterministic pass (`--apply`), `agent` = judged gesture (`--archive`, `--confirm`). Append-only, never edited by hand. Undo a gesture with `git revert` of its commit, or by editing the ref back. Nothing is ever deleted or moved.

| Date | By | Ref | Gesture | Why |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-19 | auto | doc/_LEGACY_REDIRECT.md | archive (superseded_by: review-sibling/doc/_LEGACY_REDIRECT.md) | marked deprecated or redirect, replacement exists |
| 2026-10-19 | auto | doc/ref/MOVED_PATH.md | refresh (`deep/helper.js` → `src/deep/helper.js`) | dead path, it was relative to a subfolder |
| 2026-10-19 | auto | doc/ref/MOVED_PATH.md | refresh (`notes/_SETUP.md` → `notes/ref/SETUP.md`) | dead path, legacy _NAME moved to ref/ |
| 2026-10-19 | auto | doc/ref/OLD_API.md | archive (superseded_by: review-sibling/doc/ref/OLD_API.md) | marked deprecated or redirect, replacement exists |
| 2026-10-19 | agent | doc/ref/TWIN_A.md | confirm | still accurate |
| 2026-10-19 | agent | doc/ref/TWIN_B.md | archive (superseded_by: doc/ref/TWIN_A.md) | merged into TWIN_A |
